name: Drinking
overview: Scripture warns about the dangers of excessive drinking, highlighting that wine and strong drink can deceive and lead to unwise behavior, as seen in Proverbs 20:1 and Proverbs 23:29. While there is recognition that wine may have a place for those in distress (Proverbs 31:6), believers are cautioned to avoid drunkenness and surfeiting, which can cause spiritual and moral harm (Luke 21:34, Romans 13:13). The example of John the Baptist, who neither ate nor drank, illustrates a life of discipline and separation from worldly excess (Matthew 11:18).
